def solve(case):
    lines = case["lines"]
    errors = []
    if not lines:
        errors.append("empty sequence")
    else:
        if not lines[0].startswith("Thought:"):
            errors.append("First line must be Thought")
        # state machine
        prev = None
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if not line.startswith(("Thought:","Action:","Observation:","Final:")):
                errors.append(f"Line {i}: unknown prefix")
                continue
            # extract type
            typ = line.split(":")[0]
            # check transition
            if prev is not None:
                if prev == "Thought":
                    if typ not in ("Action","Final"):
                        errors.append(f"Line {i}: After Thought, expected Action or Final, got {typ}")
                elif prev == "Action":
                    if typ != "Observation":
                        errors.append(f"Line {i}: After Action, expected Observation, got {typ}")
                elif prev == "Observation":
                    if typ != "Thought":
                        errors.append(f"Line {i}: After Observation, expected Thought, got {typ}")
                elif prev == "Final":
                    errors.append(f"Line {i}: Final must be last line")
            prev = typ
        # after loop, check last line is Final
        if lines and lines[-1].split(":")[0] != "Final":
            errors.append("Last line must be Final")
    valid = len(errors) == 0
    return {"valid": valid, "errors": errors}
